resources.string: Edit the saved embedding-model settings. Supply each optional value explicitly; clearing Supply removes only that field.
Optional opaque secret:// reference. Enter a reference, never a password or credential.
Optional whole number of at least 1. No maximum is specified.
Optional literal text. Supplied empty or whitespace text is retained; clear Supply to omit the region. No region availability is inferred.
Enter the supplied value or clear Supply.
Enter a whole number; separators and nonnumeric values are not accepted.
This text cannot be saved. Check the text and try again.
This value is too long to save. Shorten it and try again; no partial value is saved.

Review recovered input before saving it. Long pending input or an invalid credential reference can make the entire form unavailable after an interruption. You can correct the text while the form remains open.
